The mapping of public contracts relating to fire protection projects (AntiNero) in West Attica is being carried out as part of efforts to promote transparency and accountability in the fire protection projects being implemented in the country’s forests. The resulting network of contracts, together with their links to the corresponding decisions on the Diavgeia transparency portal, helps concerned citizens, organisations and researchers to examine in greater depth and evaluate the public contracts relating to these projects, thereby gaining a more complete picture.
